newsitem.title: GERMANY: HORSE RACING-OXALAGU CONTINUES WINNING RUN.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-OXALAGU CONTINUES WINNING RUN.

text.p: Cologne trainer Bruno Schutz due to retire at the end of the season, continued his purple patch with Oxalagu winning the group one Grosser Dallmayr Preis on Sunday.
The top class Irish filly Dance Design set out to make all the running but Oxalagu refused to let go and his stronger finishing kick sealed victory by half a length.
The winner's stablemate Eden Rock was three lengths further back in a field of six.
Oxalagu, making it nine wins from 20 starts, pushed his career earnings past the one million marks ($537,000) barrier as he further underlined his remarkable season.

The five-year-old has run four times in group company this year and has won on each occasion. He started out by winning in group three company in the spring and has since added group two wins at Baden Baden prior to Sunday's triumph.
